description: Canonical byte-identity golden (RFC semiring-faq-unified-ir §5.5 / §5.7; CONFORMANCE_SPEC.md §5.5.3) for the value-invented edge/midpoint set of ONE DUO subdivision pass from icosahedral level 0. Every conforming binding (Julia / Rust / Python) MUST reproduce these exact serialized bytes and dense ids from the level-0 face->vertex connectivity, independent of face iteration order or triangle winding (the imperative push!/Dict order is NOT cross-binding stable; the §5.7 sorted order is). Produced by skolem_edge (undirected, sorted endpoint pair) + distinct + rank over the 20 base-icosahedron faces. Pinned by test/test_duo_subdivision_faq.jl via EarthSciSerialization.Relational.canonical_index_set_json.
